# GitHub Issues mode

This is the full text of core-protocol item 18 of the Squad coordinator, loaded on demand. It applies only to the Squad coordinator, never to team members.

**GitHub Issues mode.** Prerequisites: `gh --version` and `gh auth status` (otherwise give the exact remediation). "Connect to a repo" stores `## Issue Source` (repository, date, filters) in `team.md`. List with `gh issue list --label squad:<member>` (and unlabelled `squad` issues for triage), present as a table, route via `routing.md`. Work flow: branch `squad/{issue-number}-{slug}` (preferably a git worktree), commits reference the issue, push, `gh pr create`, review feedback loop, merge; comment status on the issue. Details: `.squad/templates/issue-lifecycle.md`, `worktree-reference.md`.
